notes.title: 'Hot Potato' Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/7fa1644c4abe5183585191fd7a6f0b329010f452.jpg[/img]

Update 1.07 features two new boulders and some general improvements. By popular demand, the [b]Paint Boulder[/b] from Rock of Ages 2 is back and we're introducing the explosive '[b]Hot Potato[/b]' to the series. Other notable improvements include Polish support (special thanks to [i]Kuba "Mr.Kuabster" Dębiec[/i] for producing the localization).

[u]Full list of changes[/u]:

[list]
[*] Added Hot Potato boulder (unlockable at the world map with 15 stars).
[*] Added Paint Boulder (unlockable at the world map with 30 stars).
[*] Added Polish language (Known issue: font sheet is not supporting some special characters. We'll try to fix this in a future update).
[*] Fixed particle spamming issue in the world map that could lead to a crash.
[*] Fixed glitch at the end of credits.
[*] Fixed duplicated SFXs with some boulder explosions.
[*] Converted Original Soundtrack to 'Music Depot'; OST can now be downloaded independently from the Library.
[*] PhysX stability improvements.
[/list]

We hope everyone enjoys these new updates!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 is out

And yet another patch that mainly focuses on stability and performance issues. We've tackled a few more problems that were leading to potential crashes while still working on a few extra improvements. Check out the patch details to learn more information about this update.

[u]The full list of updates are here[/u]:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash caused by boiling oil cauldrons.
[*] Optimized boiling oil cauldron animations so they don't affect performance as much.
[*] Potential fix for PhysX contact generation crash.
[*] Avalanche AI boulders break when they hit the castle door so they don't block other boulders that are also trying to reach their target.
[*] Delayed win in Spaghettiland Unit Challenge is fixed.
[*] Fixed some unresponsive Editor inputs.
[*] Fixed arrows not aligning correctly during Napoleon's tutorial.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more changes in upcoming revisions!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/246b2b48dbe2b48f84b454d95b7b0106c020f251.png[/img]

This patch addresses more issues while introducing a re-designed version of ‘Cyclopean Isles - War’ that replaces the old layout. We’ll continue to swap some of the old levels with new more interesting designs in upcoming updates.


[u]The full list of updates is here[/u]:

[list]
[*] Potential fix for physics crash.
[*] Difficulty levels are operating again (select from options menu).
[*] Apex destructibles optimizations for newly introduced destructible meshes. 
[*] Unit challenge no longer fails to populate layout with obstacles if player presses retry.
[*] Music doesn't cut off after pressing restart in Time Trial. 
[*] New level design for Cyclopean Isles - War.
[*] Dragon upgrade localization restored.
[*] Dragon boss executes slow motion only on first hit.
[/list]

Notes on the new level by the author (Carlos Bordeu - ACE Team):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/0d5a564f857a40424e2557d9f18c6cddbfc92a39.jpg[/img]

[i]The original map, while interesting with the cannons, was showing very little of the new content of RoA3, felt too large for an introductory map, and was more in the style of an Obstacle Race. I designed the map with the War game mode in mind, giving the level a couple of shortcuts, some alternate paths, and some interesting areas where Mines are placed - but always keeping things simple (it is the first War map after all). I also designed the level to have several areas with steps - something I feel that breaks from the monotony of simple paths. All this was done with the editor which definitely allows for endless options. Looking forward to diving into it again.[/i]

---

We hope everyone enjoys this update and stay tuned for more content coming soon.

notes.title: Check Out the New Defensive Units Available in Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e59ca29a54412c68a9dc703505de7ae3b5c224ba.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e59ca29a54412c68a9dc703505de7ae3b5c224ba.jpg[/img][/url]

Over the past several weeks, we’ve taken a look at the [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-story-characters/]over-the-top world[/url] of Rock of Ages 3, as well as the new [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-make-and-break-new-boulders-game-modes/]boulders and game modes[/url] coming to this next iteration in July. But Rock of Ages isn’t just about barreling your enormous boulder downhill at your enemy’s castle. It’s also an equally wacky tower defense game! 

So, naturally, we need to take a look at all of the new tools at your disposal to stop the boulder-rolling madness and defend your castle. Here are the new defensive units available in [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i]. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/XtRhw1t.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/dC4IHKr.gif[/img][/url]

[b]War Elephant[/b] – What could be scarier than a massive elephant staring you down in the middle of an open field? A massive elephant carrying archers hell-bent to shoot any boulder that dares to get close.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/D1oT52r.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xLCDY2x.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Guillotine[/b] – Known as “The National Razor” in France, the guillotine was last used for capital punishment in 1977. But in 2020, this deadly apparatus will deal critical damage to a boulder that rolls under it. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/W4X63FS.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/liMBPxU.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Wheel of Pain[/b] – If the Wheel of Fortune had an evil twin, it would be the Wheel of Pain. It’s spinning arms deal serious damage and can send a boulder careening off the side of the map. Attack the center to destroy. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/CDNicbc.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xP5AURZ.gif[/img][/url]

[b]The Fool[/b] – If staying out of the way of a boulder barreling down a hill at terminal velocity is wrong, the fool does not want to be right. Create a congregation of fools, and you now have a slightly larger minor inconvenience. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2fa647160aa63a5f5f3bc0ce3d7371fca99d36ae.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2fa647160aa63a5f5f3bc0ce3d7371fca99d36ae.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Trojan Horse[/b] – Don’t look a gift horse in the mouth? More like don’t look a gift horse in the hollowed-out underbelly filled with enemy combatants! Block your opponents from being able to build on certain parts of their course with the oldest trick in the book. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/wbI3zmv.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/CVkBCHM.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Yeti[/b] – As if the abominable snowman wasn’t terrifying enough, the yeti in Rock of Ages 3 has harnessed the power of winter and delivers an icy blow that freezes nearby boulders. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/bdb2464796831ca79f229024915b2e73cc8136ab.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/bdb2464796831ca79f229024915b2e73cc8136ab.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Battering Ram[/b] – A slow moving, heavy structure that packs a serious punch. Use the battering ram to deal damage and knock back incoming boulders. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/2X3onw9.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/V1QUtpG.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Bumper Frog[/b] – Ranidaphobics beware. This gigantic frog will ruin your boulder’s day by inflating to repel attackers. Land on it from above, and it will explode! 

On top of these new additions, staples from previous games are also returning, including walls, launch pads, explosive barrels, and much much more! 

[h3]Preorder Rock of Ages 3 Today! [/h3]
[i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i] launches on July 21, 2020 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC, and Stadia. [url=https://modusgames.com/rock-of-ages-3/]Click here to learn more about the game[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/Rock_of_Ages_3_Make__Break/]wishlist on Steam[/url], and [url=https://modusgames.com/rock-of-ages-3/#preorder-section]preorder today[/url]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/

notes.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break: New Boulders and Game Modes
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/47219c6178941070299d9d9c76da85cfd9781e58.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/47219c6178941070299d9d9c76da85cfd9781e58.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

The [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i] launch is fast approaching. We recently [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-story-characters/]previewed the story[/url] and introduced you to several characters you will encounter when playing through the campaign. This week we want to focus on what makes Rock of Ages 3 well… rock: the boulders!

[h3]Brand New Boulders of Destruction[/h3]
While there will be plenty of familiar faces (did you catch this subtle rock pun) returning in Rock of Ages 3, there will be plenty of new weapons of mass destruction at your disposal. Here’s a preview of the boulders that will be available when the game launches this June.  

[b]Cheese Wheel:[/b] Striking fear into castle gates and the lactose intolerant, the giant cheese wheel is one of the faster boulders and offers better stability than the prehistoric wheel due to its wider base.  

[url=https://i.imgur.com/B5VWPgv.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZFjECL1uIRwgFJVXwE/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Giant Meatball:[/b] Is it spicy? We don’t know. But we do know that it gets bigger when it takes damage! And the bigger it gets, the more damage it deals at the end of its run. 

[b]Snow Boulder:[/b] A rolling stone gathers no moss, and a rolling snow ball loses mass as time goes by. What you lose in size as you go downhill, you make up for in being impervious to many projectiles. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2eb7540f6d494ad520e1de47da1465dffb545bc3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2eb7540f6d494ad520e1de47da1465dffb545bc3.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Fist Boulder:[/b] You’ve heard of the iron fist, but do you know the stone fist? After jumping, this mighty knuckle sandwich releases a shockwave that does damage to nearby units. 

[b]Sheep Boulder:[/b] Baa baa black sheep have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir… a homogenous blob of sheep which includes copious amounts of wool… full. It’s light, so it covers great distances in the air. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/94t6I8r.mp4][img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/W2civnuddOnjldZntN/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Humpty Dumpty (Only Available in the Humpty Dumpty Game Mode):[/b] If you think rolling an enormous egg down a hill laden with obstacles was a bad idea, you’d be absolutely right! Humpty Dumpty is difficult to maneuver and breaks after just two hits, but try to tell us that gif isn’t hilarious. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/wVMq83P.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QAJqLV0DiDvzqnL6v2/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

Returning boulders from Rock of Ages 2 include: Rock of Ages, Lion Boulder, Medusa's Boulder, Block of Ages, Armored Boulder, Globus Cruciger, Gunpowder Boulder, Fire Boulder, Angel Boulder, Globe, Sand Boulder, Pre-Historic Wheel, and Tar Boulder. 

[h3]New Ways to Play[/h3]
Rock of Ages 3 doesn’t just have new boulders, there are also three brand new game modes where you’ll be able to enjoy once the game launches. 

[b]Humpty Dumpty Mode:[/b] In the new Humpty Dumpty game mode, classic Rock of Ages action meets platforming. You will take control of the Humpty Dumpty boulder in uniquely themed courses as you race from start to finish. Two hits and Humpty Dumpty breaks, but there are checkpoints and extra lives you can pick up as you go.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/5UfQbL6.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KAdwMNxTnmT60NCtn1/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Avalanche:[/b] Defend your castle in this new strategy mode. During the build phase, you will construct robust defenses to fend off dozens of small and large boulders, as well as bombs, released to destroy your fortress. Since this mode does not have the Boulder phase like traditional war mode, you can equip more units and build far more defenses. 

[b]Level Creator:[/b] New to [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] is the level creator which will add endless replayability. Design your most over-the-top courses using the advanced design tool and easily share them with friends! More information on this to come. 

Returning game modes include: War, Obstacle Course, Time Trial, and Skeeball

[h3]Preorder Rock of Ages 3 Now![/h3]
Take all of these new boulders for a test drive down the course when [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] launches on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Stadia on June 2. [url=https://modusgames.com/rock-of-ages-3/]Click here to learn more about the game[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/Rock_of_Ages_3_Make__Break/]wishlist on Steam[/url], and [url=https://modusgames.com/rock-of-ages-3/#preorder-section]preorder today[/url]!

notes.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9399/7c60a5752b928874e8a1d81165f1251a23264dc8.png[/img]

[h1]Make your own levels. Break everyone else’s.[/h1]

We're happy to announce our latest installment in the historically accurate boulder smashing series Rock of Ages!

[i][b]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/b][/i] is competitive tower defense and arcade action rolled up with ACE Team's quirky, Monty Python-esque humor into one giant, creative game for the ages.

Jump into the expansive, gut-busting story for an eclectic adventure featuring bizarre and irreverent takes on legendary characters, or for the first time, create and share your own levels to compete with friends and strangers online in a real-time mix of hectic tower defense and epic boulder-racing arcade action.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DDA5iYi_TAU
[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Make & Break Worlds:[/b] Design and build your own levels in the easy-to-use editor and share your creations with players from all over the world for nearly limitless creative fun!

[*][b]Competitive Tower Defense:[/b] Build defenses and race to destroy your opponents’ in up to 4-player online multiplayer, or head-to-head in 2-player split-screen action.

[*][b]Boulder-Smashing Arcade Action:[/b] Crash your way through everything in your path as fast as you can in six distinct and arcadey game modes with over 20 zany boulders!

 [*][b]Absurdly Funny:[/b] Take a ride on the wild side with ACE Team's hilarious story – everyone from Caesar and Moctezuma to Krampus and the Spaghetti Monster make an appearance in an expansive campaign across history and beyond.

 [*][b]Game Modes Galore:[/b] Defend your base in the new Boulder Avalanche, perfect your rolling skills in the fragile Humpty-Dumpty Mode, race the clock in Time Trials, or create your own unique gameplay with the creator for hundreds of hours of fun!
[/list]

Official website: RockOfAges3.com

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/
